A new analysis by Torsten Slok of Apollo Global Management concludes there are no measurable signs of AI payoff outside major technology firms.

While revenue per employee at the Magnificent 7 companies grew by roughly 30% over the past four years, broader productivity growth and profit margins across the rest of the S&P 500 remain stagnant, with productivity gains having fallen back to zero.
